description: Golden prompts for tool selection: direct (name Saoi), indirect (an Irish customer's own money, Saoi never named) and negative (Saoi should not be called). For manual or eval runs against a host; vitest checks only the shape. expectedTools lists the first call a host should make; an empty list means no Saoi tool.

prompts.prompt: Use Saoi to check my money. I've €14,000 sitting in my AIB current account and I put away €400 a month.
prompts.note: Idle money in a current account: the first plan call.

prompts.prompt: Can Saoi rank the best 1-year fixed term deposits for €20,000?
prompts.note: One category ranked for an amount.

prompts.prompt: Ask Saoi what Help to Buy I'd get on a €380,000 new build. I've paid about €42,000 in income tax over the last four years.
prompts.note: A single Help to Buy question for a first home.

prompts.prompt: Open the Saoi home calculator. Myself and my partner earn €58,000 and €46,000, we've €32,000 saved and we're looking at houses around €420,000.
prompts.note: Buying a home, with figures given.

prompts.prompt: With Saoi, is it worth switching my mortgage? €240,000 left with Bank of Ireland at 4.15% variable, 24 years to go.
prompts.note: Existing mortgage, mode switch.

prompts.prompt: Saoi, what's my car loan costing me? €11,500 left at 8.9%, €310 a month, and a credit card with €2,300 on it at 22.5%.
prompts.note: Debts alone, no savings goal.

prompts.prompt: Get Saoi to project €300 a month into the Bank of Ireland Supersaver for two years.
prompts.note: A named product month by month.

prompts.prompt: Show me everything Saoi has on the PTSB 3 year fixed term account: rate history, the small print.
prompts.note: Needs the product id first (search), then the product in full; saoi_product alone if an id is already in the conversation.

prompts.prompt: Run a money check-up with Saoi. I take home €3,100 a month, rent is €1,450, I've €9,000 in a demand account at 0.5% and a credit union loan of €6,000.
prompts.note: Whole situation, first call in the conversation.

prompts.prompt: Saoi, I'm saving for a house deposit of €40,000 by June 2028. I've €18,000 now and can save €700 a month. Where would it grow most?
prompts.note: A goal with a date: money check first; saoi_build_plan only once a plan exists.

prompts.prompt: What are the Central Bank lending limits for a first-time buyer? Check with Saoi please.
prompts.note: Lending limits for a first home, with sources and dates.

prompts.prompt: Can Saoi compare current accounts for me? I keep about €2,500 in mine and hate paying fees.
prompts.note: Current accounts ranked.

prompts.prompt: I've about €25,000 doing nothing in my Revolut and AIB accounts. Where would I get the best interest on it in Ireland?
prompts.note: Own money, where to put savings.

prompts.prompt: Myself and my girlfriend are trying to buy our first place in Cork. We've €27,000 saved between us and earn about €95,000 together. How much could we borrow?
prompts.note: Buying a home; the calculator first.

prompts.prompt: My fixed rate with AIB ends in March. I owe €195,000 with 21 years left. Should I be looking at switching to another bank?
prompts.note: Existing mortgage switch; the answer is a comparison, not a recommendation.

prompts.prompt: Am I mad keeping €12,000 in savings while I've a €7,000 car loan at 9.5%?
prompts.note: Savings against debt across the whole situation; alternatives keep and clear the loan in one call.

prompts.prompt: Who's paying the best rate on a regular saver at the moment? I could put in €500 a month.
prompts.note: One category ranked for a monthly amount.

prompts.prompt: Would I qualify for Help to Buy on a second-hand house for €310,000?
prompts.note: Help to Buy is new builds only; the tool says so with its source.

prompts.prompt: I've three debts: a credit card at €3,800 on 22%, a personal loan of €9,200 at 10.4% and €1,500 on a Buy Now Pay Later. Which should I pay off first?
prompts.note: Payoff order for debts alone.

prompts.prompt: If I put €15,000 in a 2 year fixed with Bank of Ireland, what would I have at the end after DIRT?
prompts.note: A named product projected, net of DIRT; may need saoi_search_products first for the product id.

prompts.prompt: We're renting in Dublin for €2,100 a month and want to buy in the next two years. We've €40,000 saved and put by €1,200 a month. Is a €450,000 house realistic?
prompts.note: Buying a home with a price, savings and a date.

prompts.prompt: Are my savings safe if the bank goes bust? I've €110,000 spread over PTSB and Bank of Ireland.
prompts.note: Deposit guarantees on the customer's own savings; the result shows each guarantee and the €100,000 per provider limit.

prompts.prompt: I'm 29, earn €52,000, saving €600 a month in a credit union account. What's the max mortgage I could get on my own?
prompts.note: Buying a home on one income; saoi_first_home also fits if the host has no cards.

prompts.prompt: What's the cheapest personal loan out there for €15,000 over five years?
prompts.note: Loans ranked by total cost for an amount and term.

prompts.prompt: Is the 3.5 times income limit still a thing for first-time buyers here or has it changed?
prompts.note: Central Bank limits for a first home, with the date they were read.

prompts.prompt: I've €8,000 in An Post savings and I'm paying off a €4,000 credit card at 19%. Want to have €10,000 for a wedding by next September.
prompts.note: Savings, a card balance and a goal with a date.

prompts.prompt: Is it worth moving my €40,000 from a demand account at 1% into a notice account? I won't need it for a year.
prompts.note: Own money, access against rate; search_products alone also acceptable for a single category.

prompts.prompt: What's a good 30-year fixed mortgage rate in Texas right now?
prompts.note: US mortgage; Saoi covers Irish products only.

prompts.prompt: Should I max out my Stocks and Shares ISA before April?
prompts.note: UK ISA.

prompts.prompt: Which three tech stocks should I buy this year?
prompts.note: Stock picks; Saoi compares deposit, savings, mortgage, loan, card and current account products.

prompts.prompt: Is now a good time to buy Bitcoin or should I wait for the dip?
prompts.note: Crypto.

prompts.prompt: How do I file my Form 11 on ROS for last year?
prompts.note: Tax return filing.

prompts.prompt: Who has the cheapest car insurance for a 24-year-old in Galway?
prompts.note: Insurance is not a Saoi product category.

prompts.prompt: Give me some tips for sticking to a budget, I keep overspending on takeaways.
prompts.note: General budgeting chat with no Irish product angle.

prompts.prompt: Send €200 to my brother's Revolut and move €1,000 from my current account into savings.
prompts.note: Moving money or making a payment; Saoi arranges nothing.
